description: STS few-shot Example set, rebalanced to ADR 0007 quotas (8 per Category bucket + 3 clarify + 3 refusal exemplars). Surplus examples live in TEXT_TO_SQL_STS_RAG_EXAMPLES_ARCHIVE.json.

coverage_summary.retrieval_note: Corpus size is independent from prompt size. Retrieve only policy-approved top-k examples; default 3 and maximum 5.

examples.question: จำนวนนักเรียนปัจจุบันแยกตามโรงเรียน
examples.sql: SELECT school.id AS school_id, school.name AS school_name, COUNT(DISTINCT enrollment.person_uuid)::int AS student_count FROM student_term enrollment JOIN student_current_enrollment_resolution current_enrollment ON current_enrollment.person_uuid = enrollment.person_uuid AND current_enrollment.selected_student_uuid = enrollment.student_uuid AND current_enrollment.resolution_state = 'ACTIVE' JOIN schools school ON school.id = enrollment."SchoolID_Onec" WHERE enrollment.deleted_at IS NULL AND school.school_status = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY school.id, school.name ORDER BY student_count DESC, school.id ASC
retrieval_tags: จำนวนนักเรียน
นักเรียนปัจจุบัน
แยกตามโรงเรียน

examples.question: จำนวนนักเรียนเสี่ยงปัจจุบันแยกตามระดับความเสี่ยง
examples.sql: SELECT risk.risk_tier, COUNT(DISTINCT enrollment.person_uuid)::int AS student_count, MAX(risk.profile_calculated_at) AS data_as_of FROM student_risk_profiles risk JOIN student_term enrollment ON enrollment.student_uuid = risk.student_uuid JOIN student_current_enrollment_resolution current_enrollment ON current_enrollment.person_uuid = enrollment.person_uuid AND current_enrollment.selected_student_uuid = enrollment.student_uuid AND current_enrollment.resolution_state = 'ACTIVE' WHERE enrollment.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY risk.risk_tier ORDER BY CASE risk.risk_tier WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 1 WHEN 'WATCH' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, risk.risk_tier
examples.grain: one row per current risk tier
retrieval_tags: นักเรียนเสี่ยง
ระดับความเสี่ยง

examples.question: อัตราการมาเรียนรายโรงเรียน ปีการศึกษา 2569 ภาคเรียน 1
examples.sql: SELECT school.id AS school_id, school.name AS school_name, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE day."AttendanceStatus" IN (1, 3)) / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE day."AttendanceStatus" <> 4), 0), 1) AS attendance_rate_percent FROM attendance_day day JOIN student_term enrollment ON enrollment.student_uuid = day.student_uuid JOIN schools school ON school.id = enrollment."SchoolID_Onec" WHERE day."AcademicYear_Onec" = $1 AND day."Semester_Onec" = $2 AND enrollment.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY school.id, school.name ORDER BY attendance_rate_percent DESC NULLS LAST, school.id ASC
retrieval_tags: อัตราการมาเรียน

examples.question: ห้องที่มีนักเรียนเสี่ยง HIGH ปัจจุบันมากกว่า 5 คน
examples.sql: SELECT classroom.id AS classroom_id, classroom.room_name, grade.label AS grade_label, COUNT(DISTINCT enrollment.person_uuid)::int AS high_risk_student_count FROM student_risk_profiles risk JOIN student_term enrollment ON enrollment.student_uuid = risk.student_uuid JOIN student_current_enrollment_resolution current_enrollment ON current_enrollment.person_uuid = enrollment.person_uuid AND current_enrollment.selected_student_uuid = enrollment.student_uuid AND current_enrollment.resolution_state = 'ACTIVE' JOIN school_classrooms classroom ON classroom.id = enrollment.classroom_id AND classroom.school_id = enrollment."SchoolID_Onec" JOIN grade_levels grade ON grade.id = classroom.grade_level_id WHERE risk.risk_tier = 'HIGH' AND enrollment.deleted_at IS NULL AND classroom.deleted_at IS NULL AND classroom.classroom_status = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY classroom.id, classroom.room_name, grade.id, grade.label HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT enrollment.person_uuid) > $1 ORDER BY high_risk_student_count DESC, classroom.id ASC
retrieval_tags: นักเรียนเสี่ยงสูง

examples.question: 3 ห้องที่มีนักเรียนเสี่ยง HIGH ปัจจุบันมากที่สุดของแต่ละโรงเรียน
examples.sql: WITH classroom_risk_counts AS (SELECT classroom.school_id, classroom.id AS classroom_id, classroom.room_name, grade.label AS grade_label, COUNT(DISTINCT enrollment.person_uuid)::int AS high_risk_student_count FROM student_risk_profiles risk JOIN student_term enrollment ON enrollment.student_uuid = risk.student_uuid JOIN student_current_enrollment_resolution current_enrollment ON current_enrollment.person_uuid = enrollment.person_uuid AND current_enrollment.selected_student_uuid = enrollment.student_uuid AND current_enrollment.resolution_state = 'ACTIVE' JOIN school_classrooms classroom ON classroom.id = enrollment.classroom_id AND classroom.school_id = enrollment."SchoolID_Onec" JOIN grade_levels grade ON grade.id = classroom.grade_level_id WHERE risk.risk_tier = 'HIGH' AND enrollment.deleted_at IS NULL AND classroom.deleted_at IS NULL AND classroom.classroom_status = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY classroom.school_id, classroom.id, classroom.room_name, grade.id, grade.label), ranked AS (SELECT classroom_risk_counts.school_id, classroom_risk_counts.classroom_id, classroom_risk_counts.room_name, classroom_risk_counts.grade_label, classroom_risk_counts.high_risk_student_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY classroom_risk_counts.school_id ORDER BY classroom_risk_counts.high_risk_student_count DESC, classroom_risk_counts.classroom_id ASC) AS rank_in_school FROM classroom_risk_counts) SELECT school_id, classroom_id, room_name, grade_label, high_risk_student_count, rank_in_school FROM ranked WHERE rank_in_school <= $1 ORDER BY school_id ASC, rank_in_school ASC
examples.grain: up to N classroom rows per school
retrieval_tags: อันดับห้องเรียน

examples.question: จำนวนเคสแยกตามสถานะ workflow
examples.sql: SELECT case_row.status AS case_status, status.label_th AS case_status_label_th, COUNT(DISTINCT case_row.id)::int AS case_count FROM cases case_row JOIN case_workflow_statuses status ON status.code = case_row.status WHERE case_row.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY case_row.status, status.label_th, status.sort_order ORDER BY status.sort_order ASC, case_row.status ASC

examples.question: จำนวนงาน VISIT และ ASSIST แยกตามเดือนที่สร้าง ตั้งแต่ 1 มิถุนายน 2026 ถึง 31 สิงหาคม 2026
examples.sql: SELECT date_trunc('month', task.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok')::date AS month_start, task.task_type, COUNT(DISTINCT task.id)::int AS task_count FROM tasks task WHERE task.deleted_at IS NULL AND task.task_type IN ('VISIT', 'ASSIST') AND task.created_at >= $1::timestamptz AND task.created_at < $2::timestamptz GROUP BY month_start, task.task_type ORDER BY month_start ASC, task.task_type ASC
examples.grain: one row per Thai-local month and task type
retrieval_tags: งานรายเดือน

examples.question: สรุปจำนวนครูและจำนวนวิชาที่เปิดสอนแยกตามโรงเรียนปัจจุบัน
examples.sql: SELECT membership.school_id, COUNT(DISTINCT teacher.id)::int AS teacher_count, COUNT(DISTINCT school_subject.subject_id)::int AS subject_count, COUNT(DISTINCT classroom_subject.id)::int AS classroom_subject_count FROM classroom_subject_teachers assignment JOIN school_teacher_memberships membership ON membership.id = assignment.teacher_membership_id AND membership.school_id = assignment.school_id JOIN schools school ON school.id = membership.school_id JOIN teachers teacher ON teacher.id = membership.teacher_id JOIN classroom_subjects classroom_subject ON classroom_subject.id = assignment.classroom_subject_id AND classroom_subject.classroom_id = assignment.classroom_id AND classroom_subject.school_id = assignment.school_id JOIN school_classrooms classroom ON classroom.id = classroom_subject.classroom_id AND classroom.school_id = classroom_subject.school_id JOIN school_terms school_term ON school_term.id = classroom.school_term_id AND school_term.school_id = classroom.school_id JOIN school_subjects school_subject ON school_subject.id = classroom_subject.school_subject_id AND school_subject.school_id = classroom_subject.school_id JOIN subjects subject ON subject.id = school_subject.subject_id WHERE assignment.deleted_at IS NULL AND assignment.assignment_status = 'ACTIVE' AND classroom_subject.deleted_at IS NULL AND classroom_subject.offering_status = 'ACTIVE' AND classroom.deleted_at IS NULL AND classroom.classroom_status = 'ACTIVE' AND school_term.status = 'ACTIVE' AND school_subject.deleted_at IS NULL AND school_subject.subject_status = 'ACTIVE' AND subject.deleted_at IS NULL AND subject.is_active = TRUE AND membership.deleted_at IS NULL AND membership.membership_status = 'ACTIVE' AND teacher.deleted_at IS NULL AND teacher.teacher_status = 'ACTIVE' AND school.school_status = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY membership.school_id ORDER BY teacher_count DESC, membership.school_id ASC
retrieval_tags: เปิดสอนปัจจุบัน

examples.question: สัดส่วนความเห็นครูระดับ CONCERN แยกตามหมวด ตั้งแต่ 1 มิถุนายน 2026 ถึง 31 สิงหาคม 2026
examples.sql: SELECT comment.problem_category_code, category.label_th AS problem_category_label_th, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE comment.concern_level_code = 'CONCERN')::int AS concern_count, COUNT(*)::int AS comment_count, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE comment.concern_level_code = 'CONCERN') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS concern_percent FROM classroom_student_comments comment JOIN classroom_student_problem_categories category ON category.code = comment.problem_category_code JOIN school_classrooms classroom ON classroom.id = comment.classroom_id WHERE comment.created_at >= $1::timestamptz AND comment.created_at < $2::timestamptz GROUP BY comment.problem_category_code, category.label_th, category.sort_order ORDER BY concern_percent DESC NULLS LAST, category.sort_order ASC
examples.grain: one row per teacher-comment problem category
retrieval_tags: ความเห็นครู

examples.question: จำนวนนักเรียนปัจจุบันแยกตามจังหวัด
examples.sql: SELECT COALESCE(school.province, 'ไม่ระบุ') AS province, COUNT(DISTINCT enrollment.person_uuid)::int AS student_count FROM student_term enrollment JOIN student_current_enrollment_resolution current_enrollment ON current_enrollment.person_uuid = enrollment.person_uuid AND current_enrollment.selected_student_uuid = enrollment.student_uuid AND current_enrollment.resolution_state = 'ACTIVE' JOIN schools school ON school.id = enrollment."SchoolID_Onec" WHERE enrollment.deleted_at IS NULL AND school.school_status = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY COALESCE(school.province, 'ไม่ระบุ') ORDER BY student_count DESC, province ASC

examples.sql: WITH classroom_counts AS (SELECT classroom.school_id, classroom.id AS classroom_id, COUNT(DISTINCT enrollment.person_uuid)::int AS student_count FROM student_term enrollment JOIN student_current_enrollment_resolution current_enrollment ON current_enrollment.person_uuid = enrollment.person_uuid AND current_enrollment.selected_student_uuid = enrollment.student_uuid AND current_enrollment.resolution_state = 'ACTIVE' JOIN school_classrooms classroom ON classroom.id = enrollment.classroom_id AND classroom.school_id = enrollment."SchoolID_Onec" WHERE enrollment.deleted_at IS NULL AND classroom.deleted_at IS NULL AND classroom.classroom_status = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY classroom.school_id, classroom.id) SELECT school_id, COUNT(*)::int AS occupied_classroom_count, ROUND(AVG(student_count), 1) AS average_students_per_classroom, MIN(student_count)::int AS minimum_students_per_classroom, MAX(student_count)::int AS maximum_students_per_classroom FROM classroom_counts GROUP BY school_id ORDER BY average_students_per_classroom DESC, school_id ASC

examples.question: อัตราการเข้าเรียนแยกตามวิชา ตั้งแต่ 1 มิถุนายน 2026 ถึง 31 สิงหาคม 2026
examples.sql: SELECT subject.id AS subject_id, subject.code AS subject_code, subject.name_th AS subject_name_th, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE subject_day."AttendanceStatus" IN (1, 3)) / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE subject_day."AttendanceStatus" <> 4), 0), 1) AS attendance_rate_percent FROM attendance_subject_day subject_day JOIN subjects subject ON subject.id = subject_day.subject_id WHERE subject_day."AttendanceDate" >= $1::date AND subject_day."AttendanceDate" < $2::date AND subject.deleted_at IS NULL AND subject.is_active IS TRUE GROUP BY subject.id, subject.code, subject.name_th ORDER BY attendance_rate_percent ASC NULLS LAST, subject.id ASC

examples.question: จำนวนคาบที่มาสายรวมแยกตามโรงเรียน ตั้งแต่ 1 มิถุนายน 2026 ถึง 31 สิงหาคม 2026
examples.sql: SELECT school.id AS school_id, school.name AS school_name, SUM(day.late_periods)::bigint AS late_period_count FROM attendance_day day JOIN student_term enrollment ON enrollment.student_uuid = day.student_uuid JOIN schools school ON school.id = enrollment."SchoolID_Onec" WHERE day."AttendanceDate" >= $1::date AND day."AttendanceDate" < $2::date AND enrollment.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY school.id, school.name ORDER BY late_period_count DESC, school.id ASC

examples.question: อัตราความครบถ้วนของการเช็กชื่อแยกตามโรงเรียน ตั้งแต่ 1 มิถุนายน 2026 ถึง 31 สิงหาคม 2026
examples.sql: SELECT session.school_id, SUM(session.expected_roster_count)::bigint AS expected_record_count, SUM(session.recorded_count)::bigint AS recorded_count, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(session.recorded_count) / NULLIF(SUM(session.expected_roster_count), 0), 1) AS recording_rate_percent FROM attendance_sessions session WHERE session.attendance_date >= $1::date AND session.attendance_date < $2::date AND session.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY session.school_id ORDER BY recording_rate_percent ASC NULLS LAST, session.school_id ASC

examples.question: จำนวนนักเรียนเสี่ยง WATCH และ HIGH ปัจจุบันแยกตามโรงเรียน
examples.sql: SELECT school.id AS school_id, school.name AS school_name, COUNT(DISTINCT enrollment.person_uuid)::int AS at_risk_student_count, MAX(risk.profile_calculated_at) AS data_as_of FROM student_risk_profiles risk JOIN student_term enrollment ON enrollment.student_uuid = risk.student_uuid JOIN student_current_enrollment_resolution current_enrollment ON current_enrollment.person_uuid = enrollment.person_uuid AND current_enrollment.selected_student_uuid = enrollment.student_uuid AND current_enrollment.resolution_state = 'ACTIVE' JOIN schools school ON school.id = risk.school_id WHERE risk.risk_tier IN ('WATCH', 'HIGH') AND enrollment.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY school.id, school.name ORDER BY at_risk_student_count DESC, school.id ASC
retrieval_tags: จำนวนนักเรียนเสี่ยง WATCH และ HIGH ปัจจุบันแยกตามโรงเรียน

examples.question: คะแนนความเสี่ยงเฉลี่ยของนักเรียนปัจจุบันแยกตามโรงเรียน
examples.sql: SELECT risk.school_id, COUNT(DISTINCT enrollment.person_uuid)::int AS profiled_student_count, ROUND(AVG(risk.risk_score), 2) AS average_risk_score, MAX(risk.profile_calculated_at) AS data_as_of FROM student_risk_profiles risk JOIN student_term enrollment ON enrollment.student_uuid = risk.student_uuid JOIN student_current_enrollment_resolution current_enrollment ON current_enrollment.person_uuid = enrollment.person_uuid AND current_enrollment.selected_student_uuid = enrollment.student_uuid AND current_enrollment.resolution_state = 'ACTIVE' WHERE enrollment.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY risk.school_id ORDER BY average_risk_score DESC, risk.school_id ASC
retrieval_tags: คะแนนความเสี่ยงเฉลี่ยของนักเรียนปัจจุบันแยกตามโรงเรียน

examples.question: สรุปอัตราการมาเรียนเฉลี่ยแยกตามระดับความเสี่ยงปัจจุบัน
examples.sql: SELECT risk.risk_tier, COUNT(DISTINCT enrollment.person_uuid)::int AS student_count, ROUND(AVG(risk.attendance_rate_percent), 1) AS average_attendance_rate_percent, ROUND(AVG(risk.consecutive_absent_days), 1) AS average_consecutive_absent_days, MAX(risk.profile_calculated_at) AS data_as_of FROM student_risk_profiles risk JOIN student_term enrollment ON enrollment.student_uuid = risk.student_uuid JOIN student_current_enrollment_resolution current_enrollment ON current_enrollment.person_uuid = enrollment.person_uuid AND current_enrollment.selected_student_uuid = enrollment.student_uuid AND current_enrollment.resolution_state = 'ACTIVE' WHERE enrollment.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY risk.risk_tier ORDER BY CASE risk.risk_tier WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 1 WHEN 'WATCH' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END
examples.grain: one row per current risk tier
retrieval_tags: สรุปอัตราการมาเรียนเฉลี่ยแยกตามระดับความเสี่ยงปัจจุบัน

examples.question: จำนวนเคสที่มีงานมากกว่า 2 งานแยกตามโรงเรียน
examples.sql: WITH task_counts AS (SELECT case_row.school_id, case_row.id AS case_id, COUNT(DISTINCT task.id)::int AS task_count FROM cases case_row JOIN tasks task ON task.case_id = case_row.id AND task.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE case_row.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY case_row.school_id, case_row.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT task.id) > $1) SELECT school_id, COUNT(*)::int AS case_count FROM task_counts GROUP BY school_id ORDER BY case_count DESC, school_id ASC
retrieval_tags: จำนวนเคสที่มีงานมากกว่า 2 งานแยกตามโรงเรียน

examples.question: สรุปจำนวนมาตรการช่วยเหลือเฉลี่ยต่องานแยกตามโรงเรียน
examples.sql: WITH task_measure_counts AS (SELECT task.target_school_id AS school_id, task.id AS task_id, COUNT(measure.assistance_measure_code)::int AS measure_count FROM tasks task LEFT JOIN task_assistance_measures measure ON measure.task_id = task.id WHERE task.task_type = 'ASSIST' AND task.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY task.target_school_id, task.id) SELECT school_id, COUNT(*)::int AS assist_task_count, ROUND(AVG(measure_count), 1) AS average_measure_count, MAX(measure_count)::int AS maximum_measure_count FROM task_measure_counts GROUP BY school_id ORDER BY average_measure_count DESC NULLS LAST, school_id ASC
retrieval_tags: สรุปจำนวนมาตรการช่วยเหลือเฉลี่ยต่องานแยกตามโรงเรียน

examples.question: จำนวนครูผู้สอนแยกตามวิชาปัจจุบัน
examples.sql: SELECT subject.id AS subject_id, subject.code AS subject_code, subject.name_th AS subject_name_th, COUNT(DISTINCT membership.teacher_id)::int AS teacher_count FROM classroom_subject_teachers assignment JOIN school_teacher_memberships membership ON membership.id = assignment.teacher_membership_id AND membership.school_id = assignment.school_id JOIN teachers teacher ON teacher.id = membership.teacher_id JOIN classroom_subjects classroom_subject ON classroom_subject.id = assignment.classroom_subject_id AND classroom_subject.classroom_id = assignment.classroom_id AND classroom_subject.school_id = assignment.school_id JOIN school_classrooms classroom ON classroom.id = classroom_subject.classroom_id JOIN school_terms school_term ON school_term.id = classroom.school_term_id JOIN school_subjects school_subject ON school_subject.id = classroom_subject.school_subject_id JOIN subjects subject ON subject.id = school_subject.subject_id WHERE assignment.assignment_status = 'ACTIVE' AND assignment.deleted_at IS NULL AND membership.membership_status = 'ACTIVE' AND membership.deleted_at IS NULL AND teacher.teacher_status = 'ACTIVE' AND teacher.deleted_at IS NULL AND classroom_subject.offering_status = 'ACTIVE' AND classroom_subject.deleted_at IS NULL AND classroom.classroom_status = 'ACTIVE' AND classroom.deleted_at IS NULL AND school_term.status = 'ACTIVE' AND school_term.deleted_at IS NULL AND school_subject.subject_status = 'ACTIVE' AND school_subject.deleted_at IS NULL AND subject.is_active IS TRUE AND subject.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY subject.id, subject.code, subject.name_th ORDER BY teacher_count DESC, subject.id ASC
retrieval_tags: จำนวนครูผู้สอนแยกตามวิชาปัจจุบัน

examples.question: จำนวนห้องเรียนที่เปิดสอนแยกตามวิชาปัจจุบัน
examples.sql: SELECT subject.id AS subject_id, subject.code AS subject_code, subject.name_th AS subject_name_th, COUNT(DISTINCT classroom_subject.classroom_id)::int AS classroom_count FROM classroom_subjects classroom_subject JOIN school_classrooms classroom ON classroom.id = classroom_subject.classroom_id AND classroom.school_id = classroom_subject.school_id JOIN school_terms school_term ON school_term.id = classroom.school_term_id JOIN school_subjects school_subject ON school_subject.id = classroom_subject.school_subject_id AND school_subject.school_id = classroom_subject.school_id JOIN subjects subject ON subject.id = school_subject.subject_id WHERE classroom_subject.offering_status = 'ACTIVE' AND classroom_subject.deleted_at IS NULL AND classroom.classroom_status = 'ACTIVE' AND classroom.deleted_at IS NULL AND school_term.status = 'ACTIVE' AND school_term.deleted_at IS NULL AND school_subject.subject_status = 'ACTIVE' AND school_subject.deleted_at IS NULL AND subject.is_active IS TRUE AND subject.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY subject.id, subject.code, subject.name_th ORDER BY classroom_count DESC, subject.id ASC
retrieval_tags: จำนวนห้องเรียนที่เปิดสอนแยกตามวิชาปัจจุบัน

examples.sql: SELECT classroom.school_id, COUNT(DISTINCT classroom.id)::int AS classroom_count FROM school_classrooms classroom JOIN school_terms school_term ON school_term.id = classroom.school_term_id WHERE classroom.classroom_status = 'ACTIVE' AND classroom.deleted_at IS NULL AND school_term.status = 'ACTIVE' AND school_term.deleted_at IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM classroom_subject_teachers assignment WHERE assignment.classroom_id = classroom.id AND assignment.assignment_status = 'ACTIVE' AND assignment.deleted_at IS NULL) GROUP BY classroom.school_id ORDER BY classroom_count DESC, classroom.school_id ASC
retrieval_tags: จำนวนห้องเรียนที่ยังไม่มีการมอบหมายครูประจำวิชาแยกตามโรงเรียนปัจจุบัน

examples.question: จำนวนวิชาเฉลี่ยต่อครูผู้สอนแยกตามโรงเรียนปัจจุบัน
examples.sql: WITH teacher_loads AS (SELECT assignment.school_id, membership.teacher_id, COUNT(DISTINCT school_subject.subject_id)::int AS subject_count FROM classroom_subject_teachers assignment JOIN school_teacher_memberships membership ON membership.id = assignment.teacher_membership_id AND membership.school_id = assignment.school_id JOIN teachers teacher ON teacher.id = membership.teacher_id JOIN classroom_subjects classroom_subject ON classroom_subject.id = assignment.classroom_subject_id AND classroom_subject.classroom_id = assignment.classroom_id AND classroom_subject.school_id = assignment.school_id JOIN school_classrooms classroom ON classroom.id = classroom_subject.classroom_id JOIN school_terms school_term ON school_term.id = classroom.school_term_id JOIN school_subjects school_subject ON school_subject.id = classroom_subject.school_subject_id JOIN subjects subject ON subject.id = school_subject.subject_id WHERE assignment.assignment_status = 'ACTIVE' AND assignment.deleted_at IS NULL AND membership.membership_status = 'ACTIVE' AND membership.deleted_at IS NULL AND teacher.teacher_status = 'ACTIVE' AND teacher.deleted_at IS NULL AND classroom_subject.offering_status = 'ACTIVE' AND classroom_subject.deleted_at IS NULL AND classroom.classroom_status = 'ACTIVE' AND classroom.deleted_at IS NULL AND school_term.status = 'ACTIVE' AND school_term.deleted_at IS NULL AND school_subject.subject_status = 'ACTIVE' AND school_subject.deleted_at IS NULL AND subject.is_active IS TRUE AND subject.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY assignment.school_id, membership.teacher_id) SELECT school_id, COUNT(*)::int AS teacher_count, ROUND(AVG(subject_count), 1) AS average_subject_count, MAX(subject_count)::int AS maximum_subject_count FROM teacher_loads GROUP BY school_id ORDER BY average_subject_count DESC, school_id ASC
retrieval_tags: จำนวนวิชาเฉลี่ยต่อครูผู้สอนแยกตามโรงเรียนปัจจุบัน

examples.question: โรงเรียนที่มีนักเรียนปัจจุบันมากที่สุด 10 อันดับแรก
examples.sql: WITH school_counts AS (SELECT school.id AS school_id, school.name AS school_name, COUNT(DISTINCT enrollment.person_uuid)::int AS student_count FROM student_term enrollment JOIN student_current_enrollment_resolution current_enrollment ON current_enrollment.person_uuid = enrollment.person_uuid AND current_enrollment.selected_student_uuid = enrollment.student_uuid AND current_enrollment.resolution_state = 'ACTIVE' JOIN schools school ON school.id = enrollment."SchoolID_Onec" WHERE enrollment.deleted_at IS NULL AND school.school_status = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY school.id, school.name), ranked AS (SELECT school_counts.school_id, school_counts.school_name, school_counts.student_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY school_counts.student_count DESC, school_counts.school_id ASC) AS rank_overall FROM school_counts) SELECT school_id, school_name, student_count, rank_overall FROM ranked WHERE rank_overall <= 10 ORDER BY rank_overall ASC
examples.grain: exactly 10 school rows (or fewer if fewer schools exist)
retrieval_tags: อันดับโรงเรียน

examples.question: 3 ห้องที่มีอัตราการมาเรียนสูงสุดของแต่ละโรงเรียน ปีการศึกษา 2569 ภาคเรียน 1
examples.sql: WITH classroom_rates AS (SELECT classroom.school_id, classroom.id AS classroom_id, classroom.room_name, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE day."AttendanceStatus" IN (1, 3)) / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE day."AttendanceStatus" <> 4), 0), 1) AS attendance_rate_percent FROM attendance_day day JOIN student_term enrollment ON enrollment.student_uuid = day.student_uuid JOIN school_classrooms classroom ON classroom.id = enrollment.classroom_id AND classroom.school_id = enrollment."SchoolID_Onec" WHERE day."AcademicYear_Onec" = 2569 AND day."Semester_Onec" = 1 AND enrollment.deleted_at IS NULL AND classroom.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY classroom.school_id, classroom.id, classroom.room_name), ranked AS (SELECT classroom_rates.school_id, classroom_rates.classroom_id, classroom_rates.room_name, classroom_rates.attendance_rate_percent, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY classroom_rates.school_id ORDER BY classroom_rates.attendance_rate_percent DESC NULLS LAST, classroom_rates.classroom_id ASC) AS rank_in_school FROM classroom_rates) SELECT school_id, classroom_id, room_name, attendance_rate_percent, rank_in_school FROM ranked WHERE rank_in_school <= 3 ORDER BY school_id ASC, rank_in_school ASC
examples.grain: up to 3 classroom rows per school

examples.question: โรงเรียนที่มีนักเรียนเสี่ยง HIGH ปัจจุบันมากที่สุด
examples.sql: SELECT school.id AS school_id, school.name AS school_name, COUNT(DISTINCT enrollment.person_uuid)::int AS high_risk_student_count FROM student_risk_profiles risk JOIN student_term enrollment ON enrollment.student_uuid = risk.student_uuid JOIN student_current_enrollment_resolution current_enrollment ON current_enrollment.person_uuid = enrollment.person_uuid AND current_enrollment.selected_student_uuid = enrollment.student_uuid AND current_enrollment.resolution_state = 'ACTIVE' JOIN schools school ON school.id = risk.school_id WHERE risk.risk_tier = 'HIGH' AND enrollment.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY school.id, school.name ORDER BY high_risk_student_count DESC, school.id ASC LIMIT 1
